mlflow_decision.rationale: mlflow not installed; installing mid-phase risks environment churn before a registered evaluation. Adopt post-tree as a read-only SQLite mirror over existing cards/manifests/hashes. Cards and manifests remain authoritative. MLflow failure is nonfatal to experiment outputs.

lineup_audit: lineup_replay_audit.json (NOT READY for historical replay; lane D deferred to 2027 logging)

comparator.T0: L3 logistic development bundle (bundle/model_bundle.json); tree must beat T0, not P3

feature_manifest: F1-F5 (16 columns) + trip/index terms (4) + logit(P3) baseline input; F6_rest EXCLUDED; no repertoire/velocity/movement; no new interactions; identical construction to the validated L3 bundle feature build (reproduces stored L3 to 2.2e-16)
monotone_constraints_T2: increasing on b_hand_rate, b_whiff, b_swstr, b_chase, p_whiff_P5, p_whiff_std, p_swstr_P5, p_swstr_std, p_chase_P5, p_chase_std; free: same_hand, log_pa_curr, log_pa_prior, park_k, trip terms, logit_p3
blend_gate_T3: 2023 OOF only: Pearson corr(L3 residual, tree residual) <= 0.85 AND best probability-average weight in {0.25,0.5,0.75} improves mean fold logloss > 0.0002 over the better single arm; else NO BLEND

evaluation.2024: E1 (<=06-30, n=55,815) and E2 (>=07-01, n=50,252) primary rows, ONE evaluation, identical rows all arms
evaluation.metrics: logloss primary, brier, calibration alpha/beta, ECE-20bin, reliability
evaluation.paired: date-cluster B=2000 seed=0 + game_pk sensitivity vs L3 (and vs P3 descriptive)
evaluation.slices: month, p_throws, batter-history bucket, pitcher-prior bucket
evaluation.importance: grouped permutation on 2024 eval (families joint, 20 perms, logloss increase)
evaluation.aggregation: oracle start sums over 4,711 exact official starts; paired MAE/RMSE vs L3

promote_tree: beats L3 PA logloss BOTH blocks (100%-consistent bootstrap direction preferred)
survives oracle aggregation (MAE paired CI excludes 0 favoring tree both blocks)
stop: ties/loses to L3 -> retain logistic; complexity escalation stops
calibration slope outside 0.9-1.1 without registered correction
